# DiamTek Java Version Manager for Windows (JVM)

> A lightweight, high-performance, color-coded Windows command-line utility designed to dynamically discover, download, and switch Java Development Kits (JDKs) and the entire JVM Ecosystem with native SDKMAN! parity. Developed by DiamTek.

- Author: Alexéy Shishkin (https://github.com/TheHawk09)
- Organization / Publisher: DiamTek (https://github.com/DiamTek)
- Official Website: https://diamtek.github.io/Java-Version-Manager-Windows/
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/DiamTek/Java-Version-Manager-Windows
- Releases & Binaries: https://github.com/DiamTek/Java-Version-Manager-Windows/releases
- Latest Version: 1.0.2

## Installation (Native Windows PowerShell)
```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DiamTek/Java-Version-Manager-Windows/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

## Supported JDK Distributions (12 Upstream Vendors)
- Eclipse Adoptium Temurin (`adoptium`, `temurin`)
- Oracle JDK (`oracle`)
- Amazon Corretto (`corretto`)
- Azul Zulu (`zulu`)
- Microsoft Build of OpenJDK (`microsoft`)
- BellSoft Liberica (`liberica`)
- IBM Semeru / OpenJ9 (`semeru`)
- SAP SapMachine (`sapmachine`)
- Red Hat Mandrel (`mandrel`)
- Alibaba Dragonwell (`dragonwell`)
- Tencent Kona (`kona`)
- GraalVM Community Edition (`graalvm`)

## Supported JVM Ecosystem Tools (11 Universal Candidates)
- Apache Maven (`jvm install maven`)
- Gradle (`jvm install gradle`)
- Kotlin (`jvm install kotlin`)
- Scala (`jvm install scala`)
- Apache Groovy (`jvm install groovy`)
- Apache Ant (`jvm install ant`)
- sbt (Scala Build Tool) (`jvm install sbt`)
- JBang (`jvm install jbang`)
- Quarkus CLI (`jvm install quarkus`)
- Spring Boot CLI (`jvm install spring`)
- Micronaut CLI (`jvm install micronaut`)

## Core Capabilities & Architecture
- **Zero Admin Rights Required (UAC-Free)**: Uses NTFS Directory Junctions at `%LOCALAPPDATA%\DiamTek\JVM\current` to switch active versions in user space without administrative prompts.
- **Legacy Registry Mode**: Optional administrator mode that writes directly to system `HKLM` environment variables when strict canonical paths are required.
- **Project-Level Auto-Switching**: Automatically parses `.java-version` and SDKMAN! `.sdkmanrc` files with per-terminal session isolation.
- **Reproducible Lockfiles**: `jvm lock` generates `.jvm.lock` manifests with cryptographic SHA-256 digests for deterministic team and CI/CD builds (`jvm install --locked`).
- **Cryptographic Verification**: Enforces fail-closed SHA-256 / SHA-512 integrity verification across all remote vendor downloads.
- **Dual Update Channels**: Seamlessly toggle between `[Stable]` (official releases) and `[Nightly]` (latest `main` commits) via `jvm channel`.
